title: Sordland/Turn02/A_MediaDeal
description: This conversation is available If the President has accepted the meeting offer from Marcel Koronti. If not this is not available and the player defaults to Turn02_Admin_Media_Influence = false. In this conversation the player is invited to a country club in Conriat owned by the Heart of Sordland Conglomerate. Joined by Lucian Galade and Petr Vectern they travel to the location thanks to the driver Serge Wolkner. Here an ethically/morally questionable deal is presented by Marcel. The player accepts or declines.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Our motorcade headed to the meeting..."
entries.dialogueText: Our motorcade headed to the meeting location set by Marcel Koronti. I had only my most confidential and trustworthy team members with me.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“I hope the journey was comfortable..."
entries.dialogueText: “I hope the journey was comfortable.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“He would have been very happy to h..."
entries.dialogueText: “He would have been very happy to hear this from you, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Where are we, Serge?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Where are we, Serge?”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I looked outside."
entries.dialogueText: I looked outside.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After a few hours of driving along..."
entries.dialogueText: After a few hours of driving along River Eskel, we took a turn before entering Conriat. The darkness started setting in as we drove up to a hill.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I could see giant stadium lights on..."
entries.dialogueText: I could see giant stadium lights on the hilltop far away in the distance. It looked like a massive complex.

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“We are nearing the HOS Country Clu..."
entries.dialogueText: “We are nearing the HOS Country Club, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We arrived and the big iron gates o..."
entries.dialogueText: We arrived and the big iron gates of the country club opened. It was huge and outright extravagant. The main building, inspired by Lespian architecture, was illuminated from all sides.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“The location is very remote indeed..."
entries.dialogueText: “The location is very remote indeed.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It wasn't bad. I am looking forwar..."
entries.dialogueText: “It wasn't bad. I am looking forward to this meeting.”
entries.menuText: “It wasn't bad. I am looking forward to this meeting.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“We'll be there shortly.”"
entries.dialogueText: “We'll be there shortly.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“We are nearing our destination.”"
entries.dialogueText: “We are nearing our destination.”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "We entered the main building."
entries.dialogueText: We entered the main building.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“It's a very exclusive country club..."
entries.dialogueText: “It's a very exclusive country club for people who value their privacy.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“I am sure it will be worth our tim..."
entries.dialogueText: “I am sure it will be worth our time. He is a Koronti after all. Let’s get personal.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was rather chilly. I was approac..."
entries.dialogueText: It was rather chilly. I was approached by Petr Vectern and Lucian Galade.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“Let's.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Let's.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After opening the marble engraved w..."
entries.dialogueText: After opening the marble engraved wooden door, we were greeted by two tall women. The receptionists led us to the meeting room upstairs.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Marcel was standing by the window l..."
entries.dialogueText: Marcel was standing by the window looking outside at the beautiful complex. He turned around to have a quick look at us both.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He was a strikingly handsome man wi..."
entries.dialogueText: He was a strikingly handsome man with well-groomed hair. He walked towards me with his hand reached out for a handshake.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I shook his hand."
entries.dialogueText: I shook his hand.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I did nothing."
entries.dialogueText: I did nothing.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“It is such a pleasure to meet you..."
entries.dialogueText: “It is such a pleasure to meet you in person, Mr. Koronti. I appreciate your efforts to reach out and establish a mutually beneficial friendship.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He put his hand back in his pocket..."
entries.dialogueText: He put his hand back in his pocket and smiled.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He had a firm grip."
entries.dialogueText: He had a firm grip.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Yes. There is much to discuss.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Yes. There is much to discuss.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I heard about your meteoric rise i..."
entries.dialogueText: “I heard about your meteoric rise in HOS.”
entries.menuText: “I heard about your meteoric rise in HOS.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Let’s have a seat.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Let’s have a seat.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“Believe it or not I have been a se..."
entries.dialogueText: “Believe it or not I have been a secret admirer of your political success.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“I find your quick rise to power wa..."
entries.dialogueText: “I find your quick rise to power was shockingly well-executed.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“I'm flattered. You truly are going..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'm flattered. You truly are going to be the best President this country has seen.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“I say this because you have gone a..."
entries.dialogueText: “I say this because you have gone against the odds and survived. I respect that more than anything.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“Thanks for hosting us. I admired y..."
entries.dialogueText: “Thanks for hosting us. I admired your father very much, may he rest in peace.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“May he rest in peace. He was a tru..."
entries.dialogueText: “May he rest in peace. He was a true entrepreneur.”
entries.menuText: “May he rest in peace. He was a true entrepreneur.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Please accept our condolences. We..."
entries.dialogueText: “Please accept our condolences. We are saddened.”
entries.menuText: “Please accept our condolences. We are saddened.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“Welcome. Your kind words have touc..."
entries.dialogueText: “Welcome. Your kind words have touched me, Mr. Vice President. He was indeed a great man.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“It's time to look forward. Let's t..."
entries.dialogueText: “It's time to look forward. Let's talk about our bright future.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Marcel gently pointed at the seats...."
entries.dialogueText: Marcel gently pointed at the seats. We sat down around a gigantic table. Before speaking he knocked on wood.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It seems we had similar experience..."
entries.dialogueText: “It seems we had similar experiences.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Politics is a ladder. The higher y..."
entries.dialogueText: “Politics is a ladder. The higher you climb the more chaos is around you.”
entries.menuText: “Politics is a ladder. The higher you climb the more chaos is around you.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I would not be standing here if I..."
entries.dialogueText: “I would not be standing here if I was bad at what I do.”
entries.menuText: “I would not be standing here if I was bad at what I do.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“The admiration goes both ways.”"
entries.dialogueText: “The admiration goes both ways.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“Well... I am known to be a straigh..."
entries.dialogueText: “Well... I am known to be a straightforward person. So, let me get to the point without wasting your valuable time.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“It was during the Alphonso campaig..."
entries.dialogueText: “It was during the Alphonso campaign when I was struck by what you managed to do within the party.”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I looked at Lucian Galade."
entries.dialogueText: I looked at Lucian Galade.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I observed the painting."
entries.dialogueText: I observed the painting.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I looked at Marcel."
entries.dialogueText: I looked at Marcel.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Marcel's eyes traveled toward one o..."
entries.dialogueText: Marcel's eyes traveled toward one of the paintings on his wall.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The famous piece depicted a giant,..."
entries.dialogueText: The famous piece depicted a giant, sleeping beneath a village. The trees, rivers and hills were all a part of the giant's body.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian looked back at me and shrugg..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian looked back at me and shrugged. Then he raised his eyebrows, something which he usually did when curious.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Its eyes were two caves looking up..."
entries.dialogueText: Its eyes were two caves looking up at the people. It showed daylight on the far left and night time on the far right.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The giant seemed to be watching the..."
entries.dialogueText: The giant seemed to be watching the village. It was totally unbeknownst to the villagers.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Marcel pointed his finger at me."
entries.dialogueText: Marcel pointed his finger at me.

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“You said we will transform this na..."
entries.dialogueText: “You said we will transform this nation, Mr. Rayne. My conglomerate has a way of doing things and I don't want them to change.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“So, I want to cooperate with you.”"
entries.dialogueText: “So, I want to cooperate with you.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Cooperate?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Cooperate?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Please, explain further.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Please, explain further.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“You might have the people's suppor..."
entries.dialogueText: “You might have the people's support now, Mr. President. But what happens when you make mistakes?”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“What is that supposed to mean?”"
entries.dialogueText: “What is that supposed to mean?”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Let's hear his point, Vice Preside..."
entries.dialogueText: “Let's hear his point, Vice President.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“...If they were released.”"
entries.dialogueText: “...If they were released.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Continue.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Continue.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“You are playing a dangerous game.”"
entries.dialogueText: “You are playing a dangerous game.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I see where you are getting at.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I see where you are getting at.”
entries.menuText: “I see where you are getting at.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“Now, assume that the press would a..."
entries.dialogueText: “Now, assume that the press would actually protect your integrity no matter what. That the people I reach -- up to five million of them -- will not lose faith in you.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“You knew that a long time before y..."
entries.dialogueText: “You knew that a long time before you came here.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“We are all dangerous men playing d..."
entries.dialogueText: “We are all dangerous men playing dangerous games.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“What do you want in return?”"
entries.dialogueText: “What do you want in return?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“You aren’t just being nice, are yo..."
entries.dialogueText: “You aren’t just being nice, are you?”
entries.menuText: “You aren’t just being nice, are you?”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“I want two things, Mr. President...."
entries.dialogueText: “I want two things, Mr. President. Number one is a guarantee from you that the Rayne administration won't meddle in HOS affairs, no matter what happens.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“Number two is a simple gentleman's..."
entries.dialogueText: “Number two is a simple gentleman's favor for the future. Let me prove my services to you first, and I'm sure you won't disapprove when the time comes.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“This is far too risky for me.”"
entries.dialogueText: “This is far too risky for me.”
entries.menuText: “This is far too risky for me.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It is an interesting proposal.”"
entries.dialogueText: “It is an interesting proposal.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“How do I know that I can trust you..."
entries.dialogueText: “How do I know that I can trust you?”
entries.menuText: “How do I know that I can trust you?”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“I think it is a good deal. He is r..."
entries.dialogueText: “I think it is a good deal. He is right, we will need the media support. With his newspapers and channels on our side we can dodge a lot of bullets.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“I think he is getting more out of..."
entries.dialogueText: “I think he is getting more out of this than we are. He wouldn't be offering such a risky deal unless he wanted something big.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“Great risk means great reward. Thi..."
entries.dialogueText: “Great risk means great reward. This mutually beneficial cooperation will help you greatly.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“I can guarantee that you will see..."
entries.dialogueText: “I can guarantee that you will see its benefits sooner than later. We can make history together, if we dare to challenge the odds.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“Not just interesting but necessary..."
entries.dialogueText: “Not just interesting but necessary. You surely know that this is a win-win situation.

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“The media will be on your side str..."
entries.dialogueText: “The media will be on your side strengthening your position. It will also protect my business operations throughout the changes this country will see.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“My circle advised against this. Th..."
entries.dialogueText: “My circle advised against this. They don't even know we are meeting. Mr. President, we're both putting ourselves at risk here, but I am willing to trust you.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“The question is; are you willing t..."
entries.dialogueText: “The question is; are you willing to trust me and accept this offer?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“What do you think about this, Luci..."
entries.dialogueText: “What do you think about this, Lucian?”
entries.menuText: “What do you think about this, Lucian?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“You have been awfully silent, Petr..."
entries.dialogueText: “You have been awfully silent, Petr.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“The one thing that bothers me thou..."
entries.dialogueText: “The one thing that bothers me though is his favor request. We do not know what he'll ask for, and it could be something that endangers our administration."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“We need to be cautious. If we get..."
entries.dialogueText: “We need to be cautious. If we get caught or this gets out, I can't imagine the consequences.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Petr leaned over to my ear and whis..."
entries.dialogueText: Petr leaned over to my ear and whispered.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian leaned over to my ear and wh..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian leaned over to my ear and whispered.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Mr. Koronti, I have to reject.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. Koronti, I have to reject.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We have a deal.”"
entries.dialogueText: “We have a deal.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“Happy to hear that. You can contac..."
entries.dialogueText: “Happy to hear that. You can contact me personally through this number.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“I hope you will uphold your end of..."
entries.dialogueText: “I hope you will uphold your end of the bargain as well.”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "We returned to Holsord."
entries.dialogueText: We returned to Holsord.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Thank you for your time, Mr. Koron..."
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you for your time, Mr. Koronti.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“Such a pity, Mr. President. And he..."
entries.dialogueText: “Such a pity, Mr. President. And here I thought we were going to be good friends.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“It's a shame. Really.”"
entries.dialogueText: “It's a shame. Really.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“Let's leave.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Let's leave.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“I was hoping that would end better..."
entries.dialogueText: “I was hoping that would end better.”

entries.dialogueText: “A deal is a deal. It will be upheld.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“You can bet on it. I'm a man of my..."
entries.dialogueText: “You can bet on it. I'm a man of my word.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Remember who you are speaking to,..."
entries.dialogueText: “Remember who you are speaking to, Mr. Koronti.”
entries.menuText: “Remember who you are speaking to, Mr. Koronti.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I regret coming here to see you.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I regret coming here to see you.”
entries.menuText: “I regret coming here to see you.”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I remained silent."
entries.dialogueText: I remained silent.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Thank you.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“The intent is mutual.”"
entries.dialogueText: “The intent is mutual.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“Everybody makes mistakes...”"
entries.dialogueText: “Everybody makes mistakes...”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“Being a president in this country..."
entries.dialogueText: “Being a president in this country means having many enemies. Enemies that would resort to anything to bring you down.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“Let’s say these enemies caused a s..."
entries.dialogueText: “Let’s say these enemies caused a scandal or leaked sensitive information from the administration.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“These would be destructive once th..."
entries.dialogueText: “These would be destructive once they were released...”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Are you threatening me?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Are you threatening me?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Let's hear your offer.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Let's hear your offer.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“Absolutely not. I'm merely offerin..."
entries.dialogueText: “Absolutely not. I'm merely offering a helping hand.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It doesn't sound like help.”"
entries.dialogueText: “It doesn't sound like help.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“I harbor no ill will. It is up to..."
entries.dialogueText: “I harbor no ill will. It is up to you whether to accept my support or not. Let me at least explain further.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I have heard enough.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I have heard enough.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Make your case.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Make your case.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“So... do we have a deal?”"
entries.dialogueText: “So... do we have a deal?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Goodbye, Mr. Koronti.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Goodbye, Mr. Koronti.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Agreed.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Agreed.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It was your idea.”"
entries.dialogueText: “It was your idea.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“He pushed it too far.”"
entries.dialogueText: “He pushed it too far.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“The threats were unacceptable.”"
entries.dialogueText: “The threats were unacceptable.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“I'm sorry. I should have seen it c..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'm sorry. I should have seen it coming.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian didn't comment."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian didn't comment.

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“As soon as you know that a story a..."
entries.dialogueText: “As soon as you know that a story against you will break, please call me and it will be taken care of.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“As long as you do.”"
entries.dialogueText: “As long as you do.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Anything to keep me away from home..."
entries.dialogueText: “Anything to keep me away from home.”
entries.menuText: “Anything to keep me away from home.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“That bad, huh? Well this should pr..."
entries.dialogueText: “That bad, huh? Well this should prove distracting. Shall we then?”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“The past months have been tumultuo..."
entries.dialogueText: “The past months have been tumultuous to say the least, I am glad you and your family were unharmed at the shooting.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“They were startled, but the import..."
entries.dialogueText: “They were startled, but the important thing is they are safe and sound.”
entries.menuText: “They were startled, but the important thing is they are safe and sound.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I will not allow this situation to..."
entries.dialogueText: “I will not allow this situation to continue.”
entries.menuText: “I will not allow this situation to continue.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I stayed and served my country dut..."
entries.dialogueText: “I stayed and served my country dutifully.”
entries.menuText: “I stayed and served my country dutifully.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“The whole incident must have been..."
entries.dialogueText: “The whole incident must have been a shock for the kids. They aren't used to what we lived through back in the late '20s. I still remember when my father took us out of the country when it became too dangerous in Conriat.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Marcel interrupted us."
entries.dialogueText: Marcel interrupted us.

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“Oh, I know very well.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Oh, I know very well.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“Hm.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Hm.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“A man of his word, excellent.”"
entries.dialogueText: “A man of his word, excellent.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“I rarely bet, but when I do, all p..."
entries.dialogueText: “I rarely bet, but when I do, all possibilities are accounted for.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“You can count on me.”"
entries.dialogueText: “You can count on me.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We left the complex and entered the..."
entries.dialogueText: We left the complex and entered the car.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Marcel put his second hand on mine."
entries.dialogueText: Marcel put his second hand on mine.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I shook his hand."
entries.dialogueText: I shook his hand.

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“We will meet again. Goodbye.”"
entries.dialogueText: “We will meet again. Goodbye.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I can't think of comfort when our..."
entries.dialogueText: “I can't think of comfort when our country is descending into chaos.”
entries.menuText: “I can't think of comfort when our country is descending into chaos.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“When you put it like that...”"
entries.dialogueText: “When you put it like that...”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Let's just get to the point.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Let's just get to the point.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Let me be *straightforward*. Sit d..."
entries.dialogueText: “Let me be *straightforward*. Sit down and get to the damn point.”
entries.menuText: “Let me be *straightforward*. Sit down and get to the damn point.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“Ah no need be rude, Mr. President...."
entries.dialogueText: “Ah no need be rude, Mr. President. We are only here to conduct business, aren't we?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Keep going.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Keep going.”
